trending.name: lvgl
trending.author: kisvegabor
trending.sentence: Full-featured Graphics Library for Embedded Systems
trending.paragraph: Powerful and easy-to-use embedded GUI with many widgets, advanced visual effects (opacity, antialiasing, animations) and low memory requirements (16K RAM, 64K Flash).

trending.name: FastLED
trending.author: Daniel Garcia
trending.sentence: Multi-platform library for controlling dozens of different types of LEDs along with optimized math, effect, and noise functions.
trending.paragraph: FastLED is a fast, efficient, easy-to-use Arduino library for programming addressable LED strips and pixels such as WS2810, WS2811, LPD8806, Neopixel and more. FastLED also provides high-level math functions that can be used for generative art and graphics.

trending.name: WiFiManager

trending.paragraph: Library for configuring ESP8266/ESP32 modules WiFi credentials and custom parameters at runtime with captive portal.

trending.name: ArduinoJson
trending.author: Benoit Blanchon <blog.benoitblanchon.fr>
trending.sentence: A simple and efficient JSON library for embedded C++.
trending.paragraph: ⭐ 7124 stars on GitHub! Supports serialization, deserialization, MessagePack, streams, filtering, and more. Fully tested and documented.

trending.name: Blinker
trending.author: i3water
trending.sentence: Build a easy way for your IoT project.
trending.paragraph: Blinker library for embedded hardware. Support Arduino, ESP8266, ESP32, WiFi, BLE, MQTT.

trending.name: IRremote
trending.author: shirriff, z3t0, ArminJo
trending.sentence: Send and receive infrared signals with multiple protocols
trending.paragraph: Currently included protocols: Denon / Sharp, JVC, LG,  NEC / Onkyo / Apple, Panasonic / Kaseikyo, RC5, RC6, Samsung, Sony, (Pronto), BangOlufsen, BoseWave, Lego, Whynter, FAST, MagiQuest, Velux, Universal Pulse Distance and Pulse Width.

trending.name: TFT_eSPI

trending.sentence: TFT graphics library for Arduino processors with performance optimisation for RP2040, STM32, ESP8266 and ESP32
trending.paragraph: Supports TFT displays using drivers (ILI9341 etc.) that operate with hardware SPI or 8/16-bit parallel.

trending.name: PubSubClient
trending.author: Nick O'Leary <nick.oleary@gmail.com>
trending.sentence: A client library for MQTT messaging.
trending.paragraph: MQTT is a lightweight messaging protocol ideal for small devices. This library allows you to send and receive MQTT messages. It supports the latest MQTT 3.1.1 protocol and can be configured to use the older MQTT 3.1 if needed. It supports all Arduino Ethernet Client compatible hardware, including the Intel Galileo/Edison, ESP8266 and TI CC3000.

trending.name: Blynk

trending.name: Adafruit NeoPixel

trending.sentence: Arduino library for controlling single-wire-based LED pixels and strip.
trending.paragraph: Arduino library for controlling single-wire-based LED pixels and strip.

trending.name: MFRC522
trending.author: GithubCommunity
trending.sentence: Arduino RFID Library for MFRC522 (SPI)
trending.paragraph: Read/Write a RFID Card or Tag using the ISO/IEC 14443A/MIFARE interface.

trending.name: Simple FOC

It is intended to support as many BLDC/Stepper motor+sensor+driver combinations as possible and in the same time maintain simplicity of usage. Library supports Arudino devices such as Arduino UNO, MEGA, NANO and similar, stm32 boards such as Nucleo and Bluepill, ESP32 and Teensy boards.

trending.name: Watchy

trending.sentence: Watchy - An Open Source E-Paper Watch by SQFMI

trending.name: RadioLib

trending.name: ESP8266Audio

hidden_gems.sentence: No-heap CoAP (RFC 7252) client and server for constrained IoT devices.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Fixed-buffer, zero-dynamic-allocation CoAP over UDP. Includes Observe (RFC 7641) push notifications, block-wise transfer (RFC 7959), resource discovery (RFC 6690), URI templates, separate responses, IPv6, and adapters for Arduino/WiFiUDP, bare-metal lwIP, and POSIX sockets. Part of the Pulse embedded library ecosystem.

hidden_gems.name: SyslogSender

hidden_gems.sentence: Sends RFC 5424 syslog messages over UDP; forwards ESP_LOG on ESP32.
hidden_gems.paragraph: A sender, not a logging framework: frames and sends what ESP_LOG (ESP32), a library's logger callback, or the application hands it. No queue, no heap after begin(), thread-safe on ESP32, host-testable framing. Depends on Host for target validation.

hidden_gems.name: eva-filters

hidden_gems.name: ZanWifiSetup
hidden_gems.author: ZAN Tech
hidden_gems.sentence: One-time Wi-Fi setup for any ESP32 project - hotspot + web form, no app, no re-uploading.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Include this once and every new ESP32 project gets Wi-Fi provisioning for free: tries the last saved network on boot, opens a setup hotspot with a web form if that fails (or none was ever saved), shows connection status on the onboard LED, and resets from a single button hold. Write your own project logic in your own sketch and never touch the Wi-Fi part again.

hidden_gems.name: espdlx

hidden_gems.name: lightweight-shell

hidden_gems.name: TunashaHydrostaticPressureSensor

hidden_gems.name: CH462x

hidden_gems.paragraph: Static, bounded, interrupt-safe hierarchical state machine (HSM) with entry/exit/update actions, initial (default) substates, timed transitions, and a fixed-size event queue. Designed for AVR, ESP32, STM32, RP2040, SAMD and other Arduino-compatible targets.

hidden_gems.name: AxpertProtocol

hidden_gems.paragraph: OLEDAnimator brings 128x64 SSD1306/SH1106 OLED displays to life using non-blocking millis() frame loops. Features include procedural expressive robot faces, progress loaders, smooth UI page transitions, and bitmap sprite animation playback without freezing loop execution.

hidden_gems.name: JoyPi_Advanced_Nano-ESP32
hidden_gems.author: Joy-IT <support@joy-it.de>
hidden_gems.sentence: This library is a collection for the Arduino for two modules on the Joy-Pi Advanced. See [here](https://www.joy-pi.net) for more information.
hidden_gems.paragraph: It includes some libraries for the Advanced. All other used libraries for the Advanced are set as dependency.

hidden_gems.name: ATTinyBME280
hidden_gems.author: DampflokHD
hidden_gems.sentence: Lightweight USI-based BME280 library for ATtiny25, ATtiny45 and ATtiny85.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Reads temperature, pressure and humidity from BME280 sensors using the ATtiny USI peripheral as an I2C master. Includes calibration, Bosch compensation, bounded timeouts and bus recovery.

hidden_gems.name: FmtLog
hidden_gems.author: G-IoT <g-iot@mail.ru>
hidden_gems.sentence: A lightweight logger for microcontrollers: levels, sources and pluggable sinks.
hidden_gems.paragraph: Send a log line where you need it: the library writes nowhere by itself, the sink is supplied by the application, and one message can go to several at once - the serial port while debugging, the network on a working device, a memory card for post-mortem. Levels are set per source, so a chatty part can be quieted without touching the rest, and the check happens before the message is built. Critical and system levels are never suppressed. Ready-made sinks: serial port, coloured terminal output, telnet with history, a web page fed over SSE, SNMP traps for a monitoring station, and Loki for searching logs in Grafana. Telnet and the web page keep their own place per connection, so a client joining late sees the same depth as the first one. Pattern formatting comes from the FmtTiny library.

hidden_gems.paragraph: Controls laser power through three independent PWM-modulated outputs on the Arduino Mega 2560. Supports constant power, multiple pulses, pre-trigger delay, runtime cancellation and gradual ramp-down. Developed in Ninglong Xu's lab (xulab).
